name: Inferno Sol
quote: A sun that never goes out.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: No matter how much we suffer, a new day will always come. Have you seen the newborn sun? Just head towards it and you won't lose your way.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's afternoon, want to go out on a walk with me? Sol's waiting for us too.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Dinner? ...Let's have a roast. Why are you smiling like that? Is roasted meat a weird choice or something? If you can't manage that, a whole tray of baozi is fine too...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The sun has set... It's already night. Go to sleep. When you wake up, the sun will be out.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Every time I come here, I see many scenes in my mind, and then my neural cloud's clock speed spikes while my body temperature rises... Is this what they call "nostalgia"?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: My weapon? I haven't thought of a new name for it yet. Sol says this sort of thing needs a "moment of inspiration". Hm... I wonder when that moment will come?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: These documents don't make any sense... Hm? Why did the Professor collapse? What should I do now? Maybe a bonk on the head will do?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Are you going out on an expedition? Please take me with you.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Pff... hahahaha~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Mmm... That feels strange. Can you do it again?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Sol said that when you do that, it means you want to experience a Hellflame Slash... I'm ready now, Professor.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Um... I don't get it...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: You already know my name. Now, I shall become your blade and burn down all obstacles in our way with my flames.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: The fire rises.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: All of creation shall be reduced to ash.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: As I am now, do you think I've managed to blaze a new trail for myself?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Is it expedition time?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: The kindling is lit.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Burn!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: They're all burned out.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I did well, right?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't... go out yet...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
T-This is for me? Of course I'd accept a request from you! I just thought it all wasn't real at all... After Tartarus, everything that's happened feels like a hallucination that shows up in the neural cloud from time to time... Thank you for holding my hand. Now I can be sure that all of this is well and truly real.
You are why I know of feelings and the future, and so I will give back to you what you have given to me. This flame now has another reason to burn forevermore.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: It's really noisy outside, did something happen? ...The New Year? So it's like a new beginning or something? I see, sounds like a great day... So, want to go out exploring with me?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: There are so many snacks on your desk, Professor... What? You mean they're all Valentine's Day gifts? Valentine's Day must really be a great occasion... Can I eat this sword-shaped chocolate? Huh, so it was for me? T-Thank you, Professor? As thanks, I'll turn the heat up a little... Aiiieee? Why did the chocolate melt?!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Hm, Professor? What are you doing here? "You're out of energy so you don't want the other Dolls to find you..." Erm, while I don't quite understand what that means, since you've said as much, I'll make sure to protect you. Oh yes, want some baozi?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: P-Professor, today the Oasis suddenly filled up with ghosts and monsters demanding candy from me, but I didn't have any, just some singed pumpkin pie, so do you have... AAIIIIIEEEEEEEEEE!!! There's one here too! Hellflame Slash! HELLFLAME SLASH!! HELL! FLAME! SLAAAAAASHHHH!!!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: (Pants) Man, being Santa is really hard... Uwah, why are you still awake, Professor? (Clears throat) Er, I mean, I'm Santa Claus and I'm here to give gifts to kids who behave well... Huh? You're Santa too? But if you're Santa, then who am I? Miss Santa? Hmm... That sounds good too. Alright, let's go give the others their gifts.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. In order to commemorate this rare occasion, I've got my kitbag and I've picked out several different routes for us. Now then... Would you like to go mountain-climbing or rock-climbing? No matter which one you choose, there'll be a surprise party waiting for you at the end... Wait, if I tell you, then it won't be a surprise, right? Erm... in any case, let's go!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
The colors here are too vivid and everything here is just so orderly, nothing at all like Tartarus. I don't think I'll get used to not being able to set fires wherever I want either...
Still, I won't run away. I'm going to look this place in the eye and take it all in so I can figure out these memories and the feelings within them. However, I do need to flare off some of my flames... Off to the practice hall, then.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
The flame is flickering... So it was you, Professor. I'm practicing my swordsmanship now. Repeating these familiar movements helps bring me closer to the past. Swinging my sword like this makes me feel like I can grasp those vague feelings and it helps clear my mind.
Would you mind keeping me company? Alright. Now, take your stance and hold the hilt like this... Yes, good, you're a quick study. Looks like Sol really did teach you many times in the past... But for me, this is my first time.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: My memory data tells me that "The Oasis is my home". Before I came back to the Oasis, it felt like there was a wall between me and those words, but after seeing it in person, it felt as though there was a splash of color in those monochrome memories and that some part of me was slowly coming to "life". I'm glad I'm back in the Oasis, that I can see everyone again, and that I can... I... are these tears?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Ah, you're here too, Professor? Yes, I came to watch everyone train. They were a little worried at first, but after Sol spoke to them, they were all doubled over in laughter... If only I could be like Sol, clearing away the haze in people's hearts with a sunny smile. 
Hm? Professor, why are you leaning against me all of a sudden? I know... I know that every flame is different. I can't be a replacement for her, but I still want to shine as brightly as she did. So let's go exploring! We don't have to worry about this place anymore.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Ah... you found me, Professor. This is my secret base. I can look down on the entire Oasis from here and even see other sectors in the distance. Also, high places are close to the sun, so my flame can burn brighter. Now, this place that nobody else knows about will be a secret for the two of us. Yup, just the two of us.
Also, this won't be the last secret we share either, right? We'll have many more new experiences together... in the future.

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: Understood.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mhm.

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Awesome.

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Mmm...

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Eh...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Haha.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Huh?

career:
The EG 4.0 unit known as "Sol" was originally developed by 42Lab as a combat-type technical Doll intended to protect scientific expeditions in dangerous and extreme environments. As an internal-use Doll for 42Lab, Sol was part of the first batch of candidates selected for Project Neural Cloud. After entering Magrasea, she valiantly perished during battle against a clone of Eosphorus and suffered fatal damage to her core. However, an Entropic resembling Sol appeared in Tartarus some time later.

The Entropized Sol is markedly different from the original Sol in her abilities and neural cloud structure, as well as enjoying a significant increase in combat prowess. After much effort by the Oasis, the Entropized EG 4.0 now assists the Exiles in combat.
infoStories:
During the battle with the Eosphorus clone, Sol held back the enemy by herself and ended the battle by taking her opponent down with her. By the time Persicaria led a team to the battlefield, the only thing they found on the scorched earth was Sol's necklace. Persicaria scoured the entire battlefield but found no trace of Sol's neural cloud core or its fragments, which utterly ruled out any possibility of resetting Sol.

However, some time later, the Professor and Persicaria encountered an Entropized Sol on their way to meet Malkira in the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector. Although this Entropized Sol was hostile to them and rejected her memories of the past, her habits and fighting style were very similar to the original Sol. Persicaria speculated that the Entropics had somehow managed to retrieve the fragments of Sol's neural cloud core, repaired them through Entropization, and integrated them into an Entropic core, which resulted in this newborn Sol being awakened in the Tartarus Sector. This line of reasoning was later confirmed by Malkira. After their journey to Tartarus was over, this Entropized Sol was named "Inferno Sol".

Since she was "resurrected" through the power of the Entropy, Inferno Sol's nature has shifted from a Doll's neural cloud to that of an Entropic; she is a High Order Entropic that holds Sol's appearance as well as her memories and skills.

Inferno Sol's neural cloud is far more stable compared to other Entropized Agents. Though her neural cloud fragments have been Entropized, the change has not affected her intelligence or memories too greatly. Her logic patterns are very complete, and with the help of the Oasis' Medical Department, her past memories have become clearer. This might be because much of Sol's internal data is essentially Entropic in origin and the firewalls in Sol's neural cloud core were already disabled, which allowed both sides to harmonize and sync together in a balanced union, allowing for more stable long-term operation.

Although Inferno Sol's neural cloud originates from Sol's and she has inherited Sol's skills, memories, and even part of her feelings, Inferno Sol remains an Entropic who was awakened in and matured in Tartarus, thus she cannot fully parse them. Fortunately, the Professor and the other Agents in the Oasis were willing to reach a helping hand out to Inferno Sol, allowing her to recognize the world beyond Tartarus and understand interpersonal relationships with non-Entropic entities.

"The Oasis... it looks very different from what is shown in my memory data, but as I've come to know it better, I've managed to find many similarities. It seems fully understanding my memories is still a long way off. At times it feels like everyone is being too friendly... Perhaps I should keep my distance; that warmth is very infectious..."
- Interview Log with Inferno Sol one week after coming to the Oasis

Inferno Sol has differing opinions of the Oasis and the Tartarus Sector. She was born in Tartarus, counts all Entropics as her kin, and considers Tartarus to be her home. She feels the same sense of belonging to all Entropics the way Malkira does as well as Sol's own dedication to protecting her friends. The mutual influence of these two factors causes Inferno Sol to cherish each and every one of her Entropic comrades and makes her willing to fight to protect them.

Meanwhile, the Oasis is a place which she has never visited, yet is one which is present in many of her memories. Inferno Sol looks forward to it and fears it at the same time. She was once worried about losing herself and becoming someone else if she made contact with the Oasis, but at the same time she also wants to see the place which the "Sol" in her memories fought and died for.

And now that this unfamiliar "home" is within reach, her doubts have scattered like mist in the light of dawn.

During the battle of Tartarus, Sol returned to the Oasis, as though by some miracle. Faced with Inferno Sol's doubts and misery, Sol chose to respond in a kind yet uniquely Sol-like way, giving Inferno Sol a new name— Sunna. Supposedly, it is another name for the Nordic sun goddess that is Sol's namesake. In turn, Inferno Sol shared her own operands with Sol.

Ever since, there have been two Sols in the Oasis, as close and inseparable as sisters. The Dolls in the Oasis often see the twin Sols exploring, fighting, eating, sleeping, and even venturing into haunted houses together.

"Alright, we're going to get past the main gate today, Sunna!"
"Yup. This time, we'll wash away our past shame."
"AIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!"
—Security footage from Taisch's zoo

When she first joined the Oasis, Inferno Sol tried keeping her distance from the Professor and the other Dolls, as she was afraid that she would ruin the relationship between Sol and the rest of the Oasis, and that she would accidentally infect them with Entropy. However, the combination of the Medical Department repeatedly ensuring that she was harmless, the warm reception from the Oasis and Sol's own insistence led to Inferno Sol slowly blending in with the Oasis. During this time, Inferno Sol and the Professor forged a special relationship.

The Professor would take time off to accompany Inferno Sol around to see the sights, and she would wait as the Professor worked through their myriad duties to ask questions once the Professor was free. The two of them often went exploring outside the sector, and their differing perspectives often gave each other new ideas and angles of attack on various situations.

"What?! I want to go exploring with Sunna and the Prof! I want pat-pats from the Prof too! You can't just leave me behind because I'm not fully fixed yet—"
—From a Doll who claims to have been studying up
oathDesc: Burning with a fury, never to be extinguished.

projections.name: Aphotic Abyss's Gleam
projections.desc:
A Doll's new form after undergoing divergence, albeit still with a hint of familiarity.
"There exists a blade, dark as blackest obsidian, yet its gleam brings the sun to one's mind."

projections.name: Brilliant Shadow's Path
projections.desc:
The projected appearance of a divergent Doll's neural cloud in a certain stage of development silently speaks of countless possibilities.
"The incarnation of the sun, crossing the sky in a chariot. Even if the skies are forever veiled by darkness, a bright light can still shine through... Perhaps, darkness and gloom will disappear one day, right?"
